g5-M01-nominal-far-control.description: Frozen G5 M01_nominal far material point control on CST 2025 CPU.

material_provenance.FR4: CST 2026 Library/Materials/FR-4 (lossy).mtd: er4.3 tanD0.025; proxy, not measured board
material_provenance.copper: CST 2026 Copper (annealed).mtd: Lossy metal, 5.8e7 S/m; 35 um thickness assumed
material_provenance.PLA: Assumed er2.7 and tanD0.01; printed density, anisotropy and batch variation are unmeasured.
material_provenance.tooth: Synthetic layered tooth surrogate. All four 0.50 mm-radius sphere boundaries exist in every control/contrast case; only the selected site's material changes from host-equivalent er10/sigma0.1 S/m to assumed contrast er16/sigma0.18 S/m.
material_provenance.counterface: CST 2026 FR-4 proxy and annealed-copper proxy already used by the G5 board; loop dimensions are assumed for this screen.
